get_credits.description: Return the number of verification credits remaining on the connected NeverBounce account, broken down into paid and free credits. Useful for checking the balance before running a large verification job. This call is free and consumes no credits.
get_credits.display_str_template: Get the number of remaining NeverBounce credits.
get_credits.name: get_credits

credits_remaining.description: Total verification credits still available (paid plus free)

verify_email.description: Verify a single email address in real time and return its deliverability result: valid, invalid, disposable, catchall, or unknown. Also returns the flags NeverBounce discovered (such as free_email_host or role_account), a suggested correction for likely typos, the parsed parts of the address, and the account's remaining credits. Each verification consumes one NeverBounce credit.
verify_email.name: verify_email

parameters.description: The email address to verify, for example jane@example.com.
parameters.name: email

parameters.description: Optional. How long NeverBounce should try to verify the address before giving up and returning 'unknown'. Leave empty to let NeverBounce take the time it needs; set a low value when a person is waiting on the result.
parameters.name: timeout

address_info.description: The parsed parts of the verified address

addr.description: The local part of the address (before the @)

alias.description: The alias part of the address (after a '+'), if any

domain.description: The registered domain, without its TLD

fqdn.description: The fully qualified domain name of the host

host.description: The host part of the address (after the @)

normalized_email.description: The address with aliases and casing normalized

original_email.description: The address exactly as it was submitted

credits_info.description: The account's credit balance after this verification

execution_time.description: How long NeverBounce took to verify, in milliseconds

flags.description: What NeverBounce discovered about the address and its host, e.g. 'has_dns_mx', 'free_email_host', 'role_account', 'accepts_all'

result.description: Deliverability result: valid, invalid, disposable, catchall, or unknown

suggested_correction.description: A suggested fix for a likely typo (e.g. 'gmal.com' → 'gmail.com'), or empty if none

description: Verify email addresses with NeverBounce and check how many verification credits your account has left.
